digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler adapter layer — Jira-family shared code
propositions: Extract Jira-family-general shared code from adapters/jira/ into a new public adapters/jira_family/ package to establish a proper multi-adapter shared seam and eliminate cross-adapter private imports that violate ADR 0035.

Relocate identity.py wholesale and split probe.py and jira_fields.py by symbol, parameterizing vendor dependencies (ADF codec, comment limits, resolved-status set) rather than importing location-pinned modules, so jira_family/ never depends on adapters/jira/.

Keep location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) at their original paths and share them by dependency inversion—pinned modules import jira_family contracts rather than the reverse—preserving the dynamic loader's path-based resolution.

De-duplicate the three independent copies of local-to-Jira status and priority maps into a single definition in jira_family/, adopting the outbound_fields value for deleted status (Done, not invalid Deleted) and re-point all importers.

Re-point every internal importer, test mock.patch string, and by-path loader to the relocated symbols without introducing re-export shims, and update acli*.py imports only (no behavioral change to transport logic).

Enforce the acyclic import graph (acli* and adapters/jira/ may import jira_family, but jira_family imports neither adapters/jira/ nor sibling adapters, and no module under adapters/jira/ imports sibling adapter packages) via a persistent AST-walking test, not a one-off grep.
